test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

It is not worth / having the trouble / to write to him / as he never replies.
solution:
The erroneous part is '**having the trouble**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, '**taking the trouble**' should be used instead of '**having the trouble**'.
 
• The meaning of '**It’s worth + ing/noun**' is 'Good or important enou
